description.value: You restore items to pristine condition. When you succeed at a Crafting check to Repair an item, you restore additional Hit Points to that item equal to your Intelligence modifier. Additionally, you can use Crafting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Treat Wounds] on constructs, substituting a repair toolkit for a medkit. You can use Battle Medicine and Continual Recovery with Crafting instead of Medicine while treating constructs, but you must still meet the feats' prerequisites to qualify for these feats.
